title: Pointer Tilt
description: Thẻ nghiêng 3D về phía góc con trỏ đang chỉ (±6° hai trục), con trỏ về giữa thì thẻ phẳng lại.

moworks.author: moworks

options.title: a part lifted forward
options.unit: px per reference unit for the cursor (5)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Card with perspective 420 px (recipe says 500); 1.8 s loop, each move eased in-out: flat to 10 %, rotateX −6° rotateY −6° by 32 % (cursor upper centre), hold to 44 %, rotateX +6° rotateY +6° by 66 % (cursor lower left), hold to 78 %, flat by 92 %. Card title sits 24 px forward (translateZ). Cursor offsets from centre: (−58,−18) → (0,−45) at 32 % → (−114,11) at 66 % → back at 92 %. Params: tilt (6°) · perspective (420 px) · keys [[giây, rotX, rotY]] · ease (power2.inOut).
